title: Claude Code Recap 封面
brief: Editorial magazine style cover illustration for a tech blog article. Dark indigo-black terminal background. Centered composition: a stylized minimalist terminal window with soft glow, input prompt area visible. Above the prompt glows a single highlighted line reading '* recap: Goal: ...' in warm clay-orange/cream syntax-highlight color. Beside it sits a tiny coffee cup icon with 'Brewed for 1m 22s' in dim gray. Floating around the central terminal are 3-4 faint, semi-transparent miniature terminal silhouettes at different angles, symbolizing parallel CLI sessions. Large Chinese title '一行 Recap' in clean editorial sans-serif typography at top-left, with smaller subtitle 'Claude Code 上下文锚点机制拆解' beneath. 16:9 horizontal composition, suited for tech blog hero and WeChat headline cover. Restrained, magazine-quality illustration — NOT cyberpunk neon, NOT cartoon, NOT anime. Soft rim light, subtle paper grain texture for editorial feel. All Chinese and English text must be crisp, correctly spelled, and legible.
